name: BYD Company Limited (比亚迪股份有限公司)
summary: BYD is a Chinese conglomerate spanning batteries, new-energy vehicles, electronics, and rail transit, and one of the world's largest battery-energy-storage suppliers. Its storage arm — the Energy Storage & New-type Battery Business Division (BYD Energy Storage, est. 2008), supplied by cell subsidiary FinDreams Battery — makes LFP 'Blade' cells and integrated BESS products from grid-scale containers to home batteries. BYD is also China's largest NEV maker (4.60M NEVs sold in 2025, >1M exported), sharing the Blade LFP platform between vehicles and storage.
ecosystemRole: Top-tier in every storage ranking, with scope-dependent placement: #2 global ESS battery shipper in 2023 (28.4 GWh, Fastmarkets), #3 ESS cell shipper in 2024 (SMM/InfoLink), and for 2025 Benchmark ranked BYD the #1 global BESS system integrator (~60 GWh, 13% share, overtaking Tesla) while InfoLink placed it #3 in systems — estimates differ by scope. Company-reported: >75 GWh in commercial operation across 360+ projects in 110+ countries by end-2024. FinDreams capacity expansion (incl. Chongqing blade-cell base and Wuwei, Gansu) took planned battery capacity above 500 GWh in 2025.

productsAndServices.name: HaoHan utility-scale platform (浩瀚, flagship 2025–)
productsAndServices.description: Launched September 2025: the world's largest single-unit DC block at 14.5 MWh, built on a 2,710 Ah long Blade cell and sold alongside the GC Flux grid-forming PCS (2.5–10 MW) and GC Master EMS. Deployed in gigawatt-scale projects from late 2025, including the July 2026 Masdar Abu Dhabi award.
highlights: ~11.2–11.3 GWh HaoHan-based supply deal (July 2026) for Masdar/PowerCo's 5.2 GW / 19 GWh round-the-clock Abu Dhabi project

productsAndServices.name: MC Cube-T utility container (2024–)
productsAndServices.description: 6.432 MWh containerized system introduced April 2024 with first-time CTS (cell-to-system) integration of new-generation long-blade cells (+35.8% system energy, -24.7% footprint vs the prior generation); the workhorse behind the Saudi Electricity Company contracts.
highlights: 12.5 GWh SEC deal signed February 2025 (5 × 500 MW/2,500 MWh) — the world's largest grid-scale BESS award at signing, lifting SEC cooperation to 15.1 GWh

productsAndServices.name: Storage cells — Blade LFP (FinDreams Battery)
productsAndServices.description: Thick-blade 320 Ah LFP cells (ceramic terminals, >10,000 cycles) for C&I, and the 2,710 Ah long Blade cell for HaoHan — claimed at roughly three times conventional storage-cell capacity with lifecycle cost below CNY 0.1/kWh. Benchmark ranked BYD #4 in 2025 global ESS cell shipments (~60 GWh, ~10%).

productsAndServices.name: C&I and residential storage
productsAndServices.description: Chess Plus C&I cabinet (March 2025): 233 kWh / 125 kW, modular to 1 MW, AI-driven O&M, sold in China and the US with a European version under evaluation. The residential Battery-Box line kept BYD a top-3 global residential storage supplier in 2025 (InfoLink, behind Tesla and Huawei).

productsAndServices.name: Overseas storage organization & automotive (context)
productsAndServices.description: The storage business reorganized in August 2025 into Domestic and Overseas centers (Europe, MEA, Asia-Pacific). Automotive remains the group core and shares the Blade LFP platform; the 2025–26 China EV price war is the group's dominant margin story.

specs.label: Energy
specs.value: 14.5 MWh single unit (world's largest DC block); 10 MWh 20-ft variant

specs.label: Density
specs.value: 233 kWh/m³ volumetric (claimed +51% vs industry average); 52% volumetric cell-to-system efficiency

specs.label: Grid capability
specs.value: Millisecond response; GW-scale grid-forming with GC Flux PCS (2.5–10 MW)

specs.label: Cooling / certifications
specs.value: Current-version cooling not specified (liquid-cooling integration on the 2026 roadmap); certifications not found

specs.label: Cell
specs.value: 320 Ah thick-blade LFP with ceramic terminals; >10,000 cycles

specs.label: Cooling
specs.value: Dual-mode — liquid for batteries, smart forced-air for power electronics (-20% auxiliary consumption)

specs.label: Safety / environment
specs.value: 2-hour fire-resistant casing, built-in aerosol suppression, IP55, 8.0-magnitude seismic rating; validated -25°C to 55°C and 260% overcharge testing

technicalSpecs.notes: MC Cube-T (2024): 6.432 MWh per unit, CTS architecture, GB/T 36276-compliant; cell Ah and cycle life not disclosed in the launch source.

decisionMakers.name: Wang Chuanfu (王传福)
decisionMakers.title: Founder, Chairman & President (since 1995)
background: Chemist by training — former government battery researcher
BS metallurgical physical chemistry, Central South University (1987); MS, Beijing General Research Institute of Non-Ferrous Metals (1990)

decisionMakers.name: Stella Li (李柯)
decisionMakers.title: Executive Vice President; CEO of BYD Americas
background: Joined BYD 1996 from Global Sources; built the overseas network (Hong Kong 1997, Rotterdam 1999, Los Angeles 2011)
BS Statistics, Fudan University (1992); World Car Person of the Year 2025

decisionMakers.name: Zhou Yalin (周亚琳)
decisionMakers.title: Senior VP & CFO (Chief Accountant 2014, CFO 2019, SVP 2021)
background: Joined BYD 1999; economics, Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics; also CFO of BYD Electronic
2025 pay of RMB 10.1M made her the first A-share CFO above RMB 10M

decisionMakers.name: Yin Xueqin (尹雪芹)
decisionMakers.title: General Manager, Energy Storage & New-type Battery Business Division (since August 2025)
background: Previously director of BYD's Electric Power Science Research Institute
Lead drafter of ESS battery-management industry standards; member of China's power-storage standardization committee SC/TC550

decisionMakers.name: Yin Xiaoqiang (尹小强)
decisionMakers.title: Predecessor GM of the storage division (2022–Aug 2025)
background: Under his tenure BYD storage reached global top-2; joined BYD 2000 as a lab technician, later Qinghai regional GM; subsequent role not disclosed

decisionMakers.name: He Long (何龙)
decisionMakers.title: BYD Vice President; Chairman of FinDreams Battery (est. May 2019)
background: Legal representative of the cell subsidiary supplying Blade storage cells; co-presented the 2020 Blade Battery launch with Wang Chuanfu

metrics.name: Vehicles / storage
metrics.actual: 4.27M vehicles sold; ESS GWh figure for the year not separately disclosed (global #3 cell rank)

metrics.name: Net profit (attributable)
metrics.actual: RMB 32.62B (-19% — first annual decline in four years); gross margin 17.7%
metrics.result: The 'knockout-stage' China EV price war crushed auto margins even as storage boomed

metrics.name: Storage shipments
metrics.actual: ~60 GWh of storage systems (2025, Benchmark estimate) — world #1 integrator by that count; no standalone ESS revenue disclosed (folded into automobiles & related products, RMB 648.65B)

periods.commentary: NEV sales 4,602,436 (+7.7%); exports 1.05M (+140%); R&D RMB 63.4B (+17%); proposed final dividend RMB 0.358/share.

periods.period: Q1 2026 (reported April 2026; H1 2026 due late August)

metrics.name: Net profit
metrics.actual: RMB 4.08B (-55.4%), hit by ~RMB 1.2B FX losses and impairments; gross margin 18.8%
metrics.result: Goldman Sachs reportedly called underlying EBIT a beat on overseas mix (~46% of volume)

periods.commentary: H1 2026 monthly data show NEV sales ~1.81M (-15.7%) with overseas +70.7% — the overseas pivot is the offset to domestic price-war pressure.

financials.commentary: Group figures company-reported; consensus numbers are Bloomberg/press estimates. BYD does not disclose standalone energy-storage revenue — storage sits inside the automobiles & related products segment, so shipment GWh (third-party estimates) is the best storage KPI.
